g.text: Both Winnow formats · Same RTX PRO 5000 Blackwell
Observed peaks in these serving configurations. CPU memory is process-tree PSS; loading includes runtime merge work.
Q8 and BF16 differ in precision. Laya uses FP32 weights / BF16 autocast. Jev server memory is not available.
Not minimum installed-memory requirements. Full phase measurements: github.com/EldanRing/winnow-inference
